about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs --phase 5 --milestone a accepts for each of milestone A's rows (phase 5 specification, section 18), by the place its row names, so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed.
Set from the manual runs in `observed` by step 8 of the phase 5 specification; `placeholder` is gone, so the check reads these counts.

After that, when exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on runs that have them with --print-minimums and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
observed: Manual runs on main at b5efe6f6 (2026-11-26): loam.yml 45822277634, ci.yml 45822283163, loam-desktop.yml 45822288786. Each count is what --print-minimums printed, but P5-A8's desktopWindows: that run's Windows job failed one of its three P5-A8 tests on a stale element (the panel redrew its cards between finding and clicking Decline), fixed in this change, so its minimum is the three the file holds, as on Linux.
